findings.title: Homepage has no visible body paragraph (H1 is sr-only)
findings.description: Deliberate tradeoff — the homepage is a full-screen editor, not a landing page. Crawlers get real content via H1 + schema; sighted visitors get the existing empty-state hint text.
findings.recommendation: No action needed unless the product decision changes to a marketing-style homepage.
